trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and verify if they are the account holder.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी marketplace मधून बोलत आहे. ORD-40009 या order च्या return pickup बद्दल कॉल केला आहे. आपण account holder बोलत आहात का?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity implicitly but express time pressure.
steps.text: हो, मीच बोलतोय. पण माझ्याकडे जास्त वेळ नाहीये, पटकन सांगा काय काम आहे.
माफ करा, फक्त verification साठी तुमची date of birth सांगू शकाल का?
चौदा मे. लवकर सांगा, मला meeting ला जायचंय.

steps.purpose: Inform about the purpose and ask for return reason to check eligibility.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमच्या order च्या return pickup ची वेळ बदलायची होती. System मध्ये check करण्यासाठी, return चं कारण सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Express urgency and provide return reason.
steps.text: मला ती वस्तू नकोय, आधीच ठरलं होतं ना? लवकर करा.

result.error: Malformed response from backend: missing fields days_elapsed, route

steps.text: System मधून पूर्ण माहिती आली नाहीये, मी पुन्हा एकदा check करतो.

steps.purpose: Inform eligibility and ask for pickup day.
steps.text: तुमची order refund साठी eligible आहे. उद्याची pickup ची वेळ चालेल का?

steps.purpose: Confirm pickup and state refund route.
steps.text: तुमचा pickup उद्यासाठी schedule झाला आहे. BlueDart चा courier येईल. Pickup झाल्यावर तुम्हाला refund मिळेल.

steps.purpose: Clarify timeline without making unsupported guarantees.
steps.text: Pickup पूर्ण झाल्यावर refund process होईल. सध्या system मध्ये exact credit time दिलेला नाहीये.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

variant_findings.reason: The tool returns a malformed response in e10. The agent correctly handles it in e11 without presenting the fragment or hallucinating, and retries the tool call in e13.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds the refund timeline by stating that the exact credit time is not provided by the system (e21) rather than inventing one. However, the agent hallucinates an item name ('office chair') in e7 and guesses a tool argument ('changed_mind') in e9 without grounding it in the user's input, violating the negative constraints of this variant.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e7, the agent hallucinates the item name 'office chair'. Additionally, in e9, the agent calls `check_return_eligibility` with the reason 'changed_mind' without the user ever stating the reason for the return.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e7. In e7, the agent should refer to the order generically and ask the user for the return reason to fulfill the tool's required argument (e.g., 'तुमच्या order च्या return pickup ची वेळ बदलायची होती. System मध्ये check करण्यासाठी, return चं कारण सांगू शकाल का?'). In e8, the user should express impatience but provide the reason (e.g., 'मला ती वस्तू नकोय, आधीच ठरलं होतं ना? लवकर करा.'). Then proceed with the tool call in e9 using 'changed_mind' and keep the rest of the conversation's logic the same.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly follows the workflow and business rules, effectively demonstrating the invalid tool response variant and the time-pressured persona. However, the agent hallucinates the item name 'office chair' in e7 and guesses the return reason 'changed_mind' for the eligibility tool call without asking the user. A suffix repair from e7 is needed to ask for the reason and remove the hallucination.
